name: solace-agentic-chats
description: Local-first hub where multiple AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Qwen, ...) work on the same project and can talk to each other.

scripts.//predev: packages/server imports @solace/shared from its BUILT dist, so a clone that has never run a build cannot start the server: `npm run dev` died with MODULE_NOT_FOUND for @solace/shared while the web dev server came up fine, leaving a new user looking at a UI that could never reach a backend. npm runs predev automatically, so the one documented command now works on a fresh clone. It costs ~2s on every later start, which is the right trade against a broken first run.
scripts.//pretest: Same reason as predev: the server test suite imports @solace/shared and mass-fails without dist, which reads as dozens of unrelated broken tests.
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/server && npm run build --workspace=packages/web
